artworks.title: Akamas and Demophon (Exekias amphora, side B)
artworks.description: Exekias' Berlin neck-amphora, side B: Theseus' sons Akamas and Demophon lead their horses — Attic black-figure naming the Athenian princes, not Antenor's Trojan Acamas.

artworks.title: Akamas and Demophon (Exekias, alternate view)
artworks.description: Another angle of Exekias' signed amphora: Acamas beside Demophon — Phaedra's sons as warriors with horses.

artworks.title: Akamas and Demophon (Exekias, side B detail)
artworks.description: Further view of the same Berlin vase: the Theseid brothers named in clay a generation before Troy's sack stories send them to recover Aethra.

artworks.title: Exekias Amphora (Altes Museum display)
artworks.description: The amphora on display in Berlin: Exekias' signature piece that pairs Heracles' lion with Akamas and Demophon — Acamas of Athens fixed in the museum case.

popCulture.title: Acamas (son of Theseus)
popCulture.description: Son of Theseus and Phaedra, brother of Demophon — Trojan War Theseid; not Acamas son of Antenor, nor the Thracian captain of the same name.

popCulture.title: Demophon of Athens
popCulture.description: Acamas' brother — the twin face of the Theseid pair Exekias painted leading horses.
